tagline: Global leader in biopharmaceuticals and diagnostics innovation
hero_kpi_rationale: Roche is a global biopharmaceutical leader with massive R&D investments, making it a key driver of structural growth and differentiating innovation in the healthcare sector.

kpis.name: R&D as % Revenue
kpis.explanation: Sales generated by the Pharmaceuticals Division segment.
kpis.description: Roche dedicates a major share of its revenue to R&D, reflecting its in-house innovation model and its leadership in biologic medicines.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Gross Margin — gross profit divided by revenue.
kpis.description: Gross margin remains high thanks to the strong value added of flagship products such as Herceptin and other targeted therapies.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Operating margin slips slightly due to higher selling and marketing costs, notably on new launches.

kpis.name: Total Employees
kpis.explanation: Headcount — total number of employees at period end.
kpis.description: Roche continues to add talent, mainly in research, diagnostics and new cell therapies.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Capital Expenditures — investments in property, plant and equipment.
kpis.description: Capex increases to support the new production centers in Switzerland and the United States, notably for gene therapies.

kpis.name: Service / Subscription / ARR Revenue
kpis.explanation: Recurring revenue from maintenance contracts and connected diagnostics.
kpis.description: Roche développe des plateformes numériques de diagnostics avec abonnements logiciels intégrés, générant un revenu plus prévisible.
kpis.signal: Recurring base growing, revenue visibility rising

kpis.name: Vabysmo Sales
kpis.explanation: Measures revenue generated by Vabysmo, an eye disease medication, key indicator of its market success.

kpis.name: Ocrevus Sales
kpis.explanation: Measures revenue generated by Ocrevus, a multiple sclerosis drug, to assess its profitability.

kpis.name: Hemlibra Sales
kpis.explanation: Measures Hemlibra drug sales for hemophilia, indicating commercial growth and market acceptance.

kpis.name: Diagnostics Division Sales
kpis.explanation: Measures revenue from Roche's diagnostics division that detects diseases, showing its core business performance and market position.

kpis.name: Pipeline Phase III NMEs
kpis.explanation: Number of new drugs in Phase III (advanced clinical trials): key indicator of Roche's future commercial potential.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Dividend Per Share — total dividends paid divided by shares outstanding.
kpis.description: Dividend per share paid annually, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Shareholder returns growing, dividend policy supportive

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.explanation: Capital Return — total cash returned to shareholders (dividends + buybacks).
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders through annual dividends, sourced from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 reported fiscal years.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Payout Ratio — dividends paid divided by net income.
kpis.description: Payout ratio = Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Dividend cut risk, monitor payout sustainability

stories_kpis.name: AI API Call Volume
stories_kpis.explanation: Nombre d'appels aux APIs d'IA intégrés dans les plateformes de diagnostics numériques.
stories_kpis.description: Roche utilise l'IA pour l'interprétation d'images histologiques et de données génomiques via ses plateformes NAVIFY et DeepLens.
stories_kpis.signal: Explosion de l'adoption de l'IA dans l'analyse de données médicales.

stories_kpis.name: AI-related Cloud Deals Mix
stories_kpis.explanation: Share of new cloud contracts that include artificial intelligence features.
stories_kpis.description: Roche intègre systématiquement des modules d'IA dans ses offres cloud pour les hôpitaux et laboratoires.
stories_kpis.signal: L'IA devient un standard dans les solutions cloud de diagnostics.

ai_positioning.summary: Roche integrates AI into its digital diagnostics and drug-discovery platforms, without making it a central pillar but as a lever for efficiency and precision. The focus is on AI applied to health, notably for the analysis of genomic data and medical images.
evidence: Utilisation de l'IA dans la plateforme NAVIFY pour l'analyse prédictive des parcours patients
Intégration d'API IA dans les outils de pathologie numérique DeepLens
Partenariats avec des startups IA en oncologie et neurologie
